name: Camping Dr.Lauth
beschreibung: Camping Dr. Lauth in Ehrwald, Tyrol, offers an idyllic natural setting with mountain views towards the Alps. The campsite is situated right by the Ehrwalder Ache stream, making it ideal for waterside activities and river walks. The atmosphere is relaxed and quiet, with ample space for tents and caravans. Guests benefit from effortless access to hiking trails and the nearby lake, which invites swimming and relaxation.
